Rental Management

Rent follow-ups, payment-status communication, renewal reminders and the paperwork around a let property, kept in one record you can see.

Discuss Your Property WhatsApp Us

The problem this solves

Rent that arrives late by a week every month is a small problem until it is three months. Most owners find out late because nobody was tracking it, and chasing from abroad is awkward.

What the service includes

  • Tracking rent due dates and confirming receipt against the account you specify
  • Follow-up with the tenant when a payment is late, within the steps you have approved
  • Monthly payment-status note to you
  • Reminders ahead of agreement expiry and rent-revision dates
  • Coordinating renewal paperwork and any registration logistics
  • Keeping copies of receipts, agreements and notices in an organised record

How it works

Set-up

We record the agreement terms, rent amount, due date, deposit and the account rent is paid into.

Each month

Rent received is confirmed to you. If it is late, the agreed reminder sequence runs and you are told at each step.

Renewals

Sixty to ninety days before expiry you receive a reminder with the options: renew, revise, or give notice.

Records

Every receipt, agreement and notice is filed and available on request.

What you receive

  • Monthly rent-status note
  • Alerts on late payment with the follow-up taken
  • Renewal reminders in good time
  • Organised copies of all tenancy documents

Limits and exclusions

  • Rent is paid directly to the owner's account; we do not hold tenant funds unless a separate escrow arrangement is agreed in writing.
  • Rent is not guaranteed. If a tenant defaults, we follow the agreed process and escalate to you.
  • Tax filing, TDS advice and rental-income accounting are not included; we can share records with your accountant.

Questions about this service

Do you collect rent in cash?

No. Rent goes to your bank account. We confirm receipt based on what you or the tenant share with us.

What do you do when rent is late?

The reminder sequence is agreed with you in advance, for example a message on day 3, a call on day 7, and a formal notice coordinated with you on day 15.

Can you help with the rent revision at renewal?

We share what similar properties in the area are asking and coordinate the discussion with the tenant. You decide the figure.
